policy: Every one of 248 catalog settings in each of 12 profiles has an explicit source rationale, exact authored value and role-aware reason. Native CFG mapping sourced from parameters.json; runtime_test_required means no gameplay claim. This records configured rules, not observed outcomes. The 2026-10-15 final CFG route audit neutralizes 108 source-inert A-Life count multipliers across factory profiles; all actual non-reference direct A-Life settings must alter at least one baseline integer. The shipped A-Life roles now store integer-effective canonical steps: 39 original decimals remap without changing any of 216 native ranked MaxCount outputs.

combat.accumulatedDamageIncludesHealedHe.label: Healed Damage Still Counts
combat.accumulatedDamageIncludesHealedHe.catalogPurpose: Repeated-hit protection tracks damage taken over time. When this is ON, healing restores your HP but does not immediately erase that healed damage from the protection tracker, so earlier hits can still contribute to repeated-hit protection. combat.accumulatedDamageIncludesHealedHe.behavior: OFF matches Novice and Stalker. ON matches Veteran and Master. Healing always restores HP normally; this toggle only decides whether the healed portion is still remembered by the repeated-hit protection system.

environment.anomalyDamage.behavior: Effective pre-protection anomaly damage is modeled as: individual base damage x Global Anomaly Damage. The vanilla setting is 30% on Novice, 100% on Stalker, 145% on Veteran and 175% on Master.
environment.anomalyDamage.settingPolicy: Source-native anomaly damage/effect; risk is a setting, not measured player death probability.

Immersive.reason: anomalies remain dangerous but readable and escapable; Global Anomaly Damage set to 1.15 (above Stalker reference 1), while keeping its distinct CFG source.

Tactical.reason: anomalies punish rushed positioning; Global Anomaly Damage set to 1.15 (below Veteran reference 1.45), while keeping its distinct CFG source.

Field Medic.reason: lower hazard pressure lets treatment dominate; Global Anomaly Damage set to 1.1 (above Stalker reference 1), while keeping its distinct CFG source.

Anomaly Runner.reason: highest anomaly-route exposure is balanced by artifact value and medicine; Global Anomaly Damage set to 1.55 (above Stalker reference 1), while keeping its distinct CFG source.

Wanderer.reason: routes require awareness, not unavoidable hazard death; Global Anomaly Damage set to 1.35 (above Stalker reference 1), while keeping its distinct CFG source.

Mercenary.reason: contract routes retain environmental risk; Global Anomaly Damage set to 1.15 (below Veteran reference 1.45), while keeping its distinct CFG source.

advanced.starvationMechanics.label: Master Starvation Penalties
advanced.starvationMechanics.catalogPurpose: Enables the extra starvation punishment bundle that vanilla Master adds on top of the normal hunger system. It is a discrete mechanics switch, not another hunger setting.
advanced.starvationMechanics.behavior: When the game reaches its severe-hunger state, this bundle adds +200% stamina drain, periodic 4 HP starvation damage on a 10-second interval after its delay, and -100% health regeneration. OFF leaves only the normal hunger effects.
advanced.starvationMechanics.settingPolicy: Keep Master starvation bundle enabled: slower hunger cadence still has serious late consequences.
